system.description:
Add-On (Passive): Add-Ons are made to an item with the Clothes Set property. They take no item slot: denote them on the Clothing Set to which they are added.

Shrimp (Passive): Prerequisite: Boots. When you purchase this item, apply it to a pair of boots. When you wear that pair of boots, you can 5ft adjust in water.

No Item Slot · 50gc · Clothing Add-Ons, rulebook p.199
